pages.text: Empty-hand right-click eligible grass, frosted grass, reeds or other plants. Pick up the green bundle. Right-click the top of a suitable stone with the bundle.

pages.name: Work surface
pages.text: Bundle on stone. The workpiece block is not crafted.

pages.title: Cleaning: 64 cells
pages.text: Flip through the frames: green bundle → cleaning → golden fiber. Left-click a cell; scraper clears a cross.

pages.title: Hand processing
pages.text: Clean all 64 cells by hand without tools. Sneak + left-click retrieves the unfinished bundle with its progress. When all cells are golden, left-click again for four fibers.
Without a workbench: 2 fibers → 1 thread, 3 threads → 1 cloth in the 2×2 grid. Spindle and loom improve yield: 2 fibers → 4 threads, 3 threads → 2 cloth.
